Shell(node -e " const i = require('@gravity-ui/icons'); const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const set = new Set(Object.keys(i)); const errors = []; function walk(dir) { for (const f of fs.readdirSync(dir)) { const p = path.join(dir, f); const s = fs.statSync(p); if (s.isDirectory()) walk(p); else if (/\.(js|jsx)$/.test(f)) { const src = fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf8'); // Match multi-line imports too const m = src.match(/import\s*\{([\s\S]*?)\}\s*from\s*['\"]@gravity-ui\/icons['\"]/g); if (!m) continue; for (const block of m) { const inner = block.match(/\{([\s\S]*?)\}/)[1]; for (const line of inner.split(',')) { // Strip comments + whitespace, take the first identifier const cleaned = line.replace(/\/\/.*\$/m, '').trim().split(/[\s,]+/)[0]; if (cleaned && /^[A-Z]/.test(cleaned) && !set.has(cleaned)) { errors.push(p.replace('src/', '') + ': MISS ' + cleaned); } } } } } } walk('src'); if (errors.length) errors.forEach(e => console.log(e)); else console.log('OK all gravity-ui/icons imports resolve to v2.21.0 exports'); ")

Shell(node -e " const i = require('@gravity-ui/icons'); const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const set = new Set(Object.keys(i)); const errors = []; function walk(dir) { for (const f of fs.readdirSync(dir)) { const p = path.join(dir, f); const s = fs.statSync(p); if (s.isDirectory()) walk(p); else if (/\.(js|jsx)$/.test(f)) { const src = fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf8'); // Find each gravity-ui/icons import block const re = /import\s*\{([\s\S]*?)\}\s*from\s*['\"]@gravity-ui\/icons['\"]/g; let m; while ((m = re.exec(src)) !== null) { const inner = m[1]; for (const line of inner.split(',')) { const cleaned = line.replace(/\/\/[^\n]*/g, '').trim(); const tok = cleaned.split(/[\s{]+/)[0]; if (tok && /^[A-Z]/.test(tok) && !set.has(tok)) { errors.push(p.replace('src/', '') + ': MISS ' + tok); } } } } } } walk('src'); if (errors.length) errors.forEach(e => console.log(e)); else console.log('OK — all @gravity-ui/icons imports resolve to v2.21.0 exports'); ")

Shell(node -e " const i = require('@gravity-ui/icons'); const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const set = new Set(Object.keys(i)); const errors = []; function checkFile(p) { const src = fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf8'); // Find each gravity-ui/icons import block including its braces across lines const re = /import\s*\{([\s\S]*?)\}\s*from\s*['\"]@gravity-ui\/icons['\"]/g; let m; while ((m = re.exec(src)) !== null) { const inner = m[1]; // Split by commas that are NOT inside braces let depth = 0; let cur = ''; const lines = []; for (const c of inner) { if (c === '{') depth++; else if (c === '}') depth--; if (c === ',' && depth === 0) { lines.push(cur); cur = ''; } else { cur += c; } } if (cur.trim()) lines.push(cur); for (const l of lines) { const cleaned = l.replace(/\/\/[^\n]*/g, '').trim(); const tok = cleaned.split(/[\s{]+/)[0]; if (tok && /^[A-Z]/.test(tok) && !set.has(tok)) { errors.push(p.replace('src/', '') + ': MISS ' + tok); } } } } function walk(dir) { for (const f of fs.readdirSync(dir)) { const p = path.join(dir, f); const s = fs.statSync(p); if (s.isDirectory()) walk(p); else if (/\.(js|jsx)$/.test(f)) checkFile(p); } } walk('src'); if (errors.length) errors.forEach(e => console.log(e)); else console.log('OK — all @gravity-ui/icons imports resolve to v2.21.0 exports'); ")
